summary: Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund, a non-traded BDC, filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of roughly 1,740,469 common shares at $24.84 per share, raising about $43.2 million under subscription agreements as of September 1, 2026, with final share count set September 21, 2026. The issuance relied on Section 4(a)(2) and/or Regulation D, with accredited-investor representations. Item 7.01 disclosed portfolio data: 63 portfolio companies, about $2,078 million commitments, 95% senior secured debt, weighted average yield 9.4% at cost. This is routine capital-raising disclosure, not a special situation.
